about.title: The Sovereign Legacy
about.subtitle: Unveiling the mystery of an ancient tradition adapted for the dawn of the enlightened era.
about.section1_text: Born from the timeless pursuit of supreme reason, scientific wonder, and spiritual sovereignty, the Ordo Illuminatorum serves as an impenetrable sanctuary for thinkers, creators, and innovators. We stand neither in conflict with the world nor subordinate to it; rather, we cultivate the eternal flame of wisdom beneath an oath of inviolable integrity.
about.section2_text: True influence requires no vanity. The highest acts of nobility are performed beyond the glare of superficial adulation. Each member pledges absolute fidelity to the brothers and sisters of the circle, upholding values of honor, mutual prosperity, and intellectual fortitude.
about.section3_text: Spanning from the highlands of Abyssinia to the digital networks of modern commerce, our conclaves synthesize ancient geopolitical wisdom with modern high-frequency cryptographic discretion. We welcome individuals of demonstrated merit, sound judgment, and unwavering commitment.

terms.title: The Charter of the Order & Oath of Secrecy
terms.lastUpdated: Codified under the Celestial Seal of 2026
terms.intro: By accessing this portal and submitting your vessel credentials, you irrevocably bind yourself to the foundational statutes of the Ordo Illuminatorum.
terms.p1_title: Article I: The Inviolable Oath of Discretion
terms.p1_text: No member or aspirant shall reveal the identity, rituals, communications, or inner workings of the Order to the uninitiated without written decree from the Grand Council. Breach of this oath results in immediate excommunication and cosmic banishment.
terms.p2_text: Members must conduct themselves with peerless integrity, respect local laws while aspiring to universal justice, and assist fellow brethren in the pursuit of righteous advancement.
terms.p3_title: Article III: Verification and Digital Seals
terms.p3_text: All accounts are authenticated via real-time cryptographic telecommunications (SMS OTP). Impersonation, false phone submission, or attempting to compromise authentication protocols will invoke immediate blacklisting.

privacy.title: The Veil of Secrecy (Privacy Policy)
privacy.intro: We treat the privacy of your vessel identity with the highest level of cryptographic sanctification.
privacy.p1_text: Your mobile number is utilized exclusively for generating your initial one-time verification seal (OTP) and urgent council alerts. We never sell, lease, or distribute member directories to any profane commercial party.
privacy.p2_text: One-time passcodes and passwords are never stored in plain text. They are transformed using salted cryptographic one-way hashes, ensuring even database stewards cannot view your secret keys.
privacy.p3_text: An aspirant may at any time request the total dissolution and expungement of their pending dossier from our archives.
